events.title: BWA Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Cost Controls, Charging Exit
events.body: BorgWarner beats on Q1 EPS and revenues as margins improve on cost controls, offsetting a 4.2% organic sales drop and mixed segment demand.

events.title: ALSN Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Off-Highway Additions
events.body: ALSN tops Q1 estimates as Off-Highway acquisition boosts revenues, though integration costs weigh on margins and profitability.

events.title: Magna Beats Q1 Earnings Estimates, Revises 2026 Sales Outlook
events.body: MGA beats Q1 estimates with surging earnings, strong margins and cash flow gains despite weak global vehicle production.

events.title: Lear Q1 Earnings Surpass Expectations on Increased Volumes
events.body: LEA beats Q1 earnings on stronger margins despite softer production, while buybacks and improved cash flow highlight disciplined capital returns.
